formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the allowance of `spender` over the owner's LLCassaUSDC vault shares to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit -> _approve).
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce, so any other signed permit with the same nonce becomes invalid.
The signature can only be submitted up to `deadline`. The allowance it sets does not expire.

With the allowance, the spender can transferFrom the shares, or call ERC-4626 withdraw/redeem with this owner, which burns the shares and sends the USDC to any receiver the spender picks. type(uint256).max is never reduced.
formats.shown: "Authorize share spending" / "Approve {value} LLCassaUSDC for {spender} until {deadline}", with the owner, the spender, the allowance in shares (Unlimited at max), the signature deadline as a date, and the nonce.

findings.title: Permit interpolated intent says the approval lasts "until {deadline}", but the allowance never expires.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json interpolatedIntent "Approve {value} for {spender} until {deadline}"; case 0 renders "Approve 1.5 LLCassaUSDC for 0x972F… until 2030-01-01 00:00:00Z". ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit checks the deadline only for the signature: `if (block.timestamp > deadline) revert ERC2612ExpiredSignature(deadline);` then `_approve(owner, spender, value)`, and nothing removes the allowance after the deadline. The field label "Signature deadline" is correct, but the sentence says something else.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Approve {value} for {spender} (signature valid until {deadline})" or "Approve {value} for {spender}".

findings.title: Permit intent "Authorize share spending" does not say the spender can redeem the shares for USDC to any receiver.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw/redeem call super.withdraw/redeem(…, receiver, owner). ERC4626Upgradeable spends the allowance when caller != owner, then burns the owner's shares and sends USDC to `receiver`. The descriptor intent is "Authorize share spending".
findings.fix: Optionally change intent to "Allow spender to move or redeem your shares".
